titulo: Al + infinitive / perfect infinitive = when doing / because of doing
subtitulo: Al llegar, me llamas. Al haber estudiado, aprobó.
regla: Al + infinitive = when / on / upon doing (time) or because of doing (cause). Al + haber + participle presents the action as already completed: al haber terminado = having finished / because he had finished.

bloques.texto: **Al** + infinitive packs a whole clause into a few words. It has two meanings:

lista.texto: _when, while, upon, on doing_: **al calentar la leche** = _while heating the milk_.
_because, since, as_: **al portarse tan mal** = _because he behaved so badly_.

bloques.texto: The exact timing isn't spelled out; context tells you if it's _during_, _when_ or _right after_.
**Al** + **haber** + participle (the perfect infinitive) shows the action was **already finished** before the main one.
Tip: **al** + infinitive is a clause on a diet: no subject, no conjugation.

lista.en: I burned myself while heating the milk.
She fainted on reading the news.

lista.es: ==Al llegar== a la casa, mándame un mensaje.
lista.en: When you get home, send me a text.

lista.es: ==Al terminar== la sesión antes de tiempo, pudimos volver temprano.
lista.en: Since the session ended early, we were able to get back early.

lista.es: ==Al portarse== tan mal, lo expulsaron de la escuela.
lista.en: Because he behaved so badly, he was expelled from school.

lista.es: ==Al haber calentado== la leche, me quemé.
lista.en: Having heated the milk, I burned myself.

lista.es: ==Al haberse portado== tan mal, lo expulsaron de la escuela.
lista.en: Because he had behaved so badly, he was expelled from school.

bloques.texto: Say it out loud, then open the answer.

lista.p: In Spanish: _When I opened the door, I saw the cat._
lista.r: Al abrir la puerta, vi al gato.

lista.p: In Spanish: _Having lost the keys, we couldn't get in._
lista.r: Al haber perdido las llaves, no pudimos entrar.

lista.p: Fix it: _Al saliendo de casa, llovía._
